title: Picture 1: Gardening together
beschreibung: What are these people doing together? What tools are they using?
Who do you think these people are? Why are they working together?
persoenlich: Do you have a garden or a balcony? What do you grow there? (An examiner would say vous: Avez-vous un jardin ?)
Do you like working with plants? Why, or why not?
Do you like doing jobs together with other people? Which jobs?
In your country, do many people have a garden? And in the town where you live now?
imageNeeded: Two people laughing in a plant nursery among small conifers: a woman with gloves and a spray bottle, a man in blue overalls holding pruning shears. Daylight.

title: Picture 2: People on a tram
beschreibung: Describe how the people are sitting. What do they look like?
What is this picture about? How do the people look: tired, bored, happy?
persoenlich: Do you often go by bus, tram or métro? How long is your journey? How do you feel on the way?
Is a long journey tiring for you? Why?
How do you get to work or to your French class?
What do you like doing on a long journey?
imageNeeded: Passengers on a tram, tired, some looking out of the window or at their phones. An older man in a blue hat at the front.
imageQuery: tired passengers bus public transport commute

title: Picture 3: A young man and an older woman
beschreibung: Qu'est-ce qui se passe ici ? Quel lien imaginez-vous entre ces deux personnes ?
Où cela pourrait-il être ? Décrivez le lieu et la saison.
persoenlich: Vous arrive-t-il d'aider des personnes que vous ne connaissez pas dans le bus ou dans le métro ? Cédez-vous votre place ?
Est-il important d'aider les personnes âgées ? Pourquoi ?
Dans votre pays, comment les jeunes montrent-ils leur respect aux personnes âgées ?
Avez-vous déjà aidé quelqu'un qui venait d'arriver dans votre ville ? Que s'est-il passé ?
imageNeeded: A young man and an older woman walking in a park in sports clothes, towels round their necks, water bottles in hand; he has an arm round her shoulders and she is laughing.
imageQuery: young man helping senior woman walk holding arm
